title: Protocol for cell-type-specific tissue reconstruction in the murine lung fibrogenic microenvironment
protocol: Anesthetize mice by intraperitoneal injection of pentobarbital and heparin sodium.
Dissect the mice after anesthetization.
Expose the trachea and intubate a 20-gauge catheter into the trachea.
Secure the inserted catheter with sutures.
Open the abdominal cavity.
Euthanize mice via transection of the abdominal aorta.
Open the thoracic cavity.
Perfuse the lungs with 10 mL of cold 0.9% saline from the right ventricle.
Instill a protease mix into the lungs through the catheter inserted into the trachea.
Instill low-melting point (LMP) agarose into the lungs through the catheter inserted into the trachea.
Place the treated lungs on an ice pack to solidify the LMP agarose.
Instill 1.5 mL of protease mix into the lungs through the intubated catheter.
Instill 0.2 mL of 1% LMP agarose solution through the catheter.
Cover the trachea with ice and wait for 2 minutes.
Remove the lungs from the thoracic cavity.
Incubate the resected lungs in 2 mL of HBSS at 37°C for 30 min.
Separate each lobe of the lungs.
Transfer separated lung lobes to a gentleMACS C tube containing 5 mL of processing medium.
Dissociate tissues in a gentleMACS C tube with the preset program B_01.
Add 100 μL of DNase I and incubate at 37°C for 3 minutes.
Obtain human lung parenchyma or cancer tissues from patients undergoing lung resection due to lung cancer.
Mince lung parenchyma or cancer tissues into small fragments (10–50 mm3) using sterilized scissors.
Transfer tissue fragments into 50 mL conical tubes containing 5 mL of protease mix and incubate at 37°C for 1 h.
Transfer digested tissues to a gentleMACS C tube.
Dissociate tissues in a gentleMACS C tube with the preset program B_01.
Add 100 μL of DNase I and incubate at 37°C for 3 min.
Filter cell suspension through a 70 μm cell strainer placed on a 50 mL conical tube moistened with processing medium.
Rinse the 70 μm cell strainer with 2 mL of processing medium and transfer the flow-through to a 40 μm cell strainer.
Rinse the 40 μm cell strainer with the remaining processing medium.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 250 × g for 8 minutes at 8°C.
Discard the supernatant, resuspend the pellet in 4 mL of RBC lysis buffer, and incubate at 20°C for 3 minutes.
Add 20 mL of PBS to the cells after lysis.
Centrifuge the cell suspension again at 250 × g for 8 minutes at 8°C.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in sorting buffer or PBS as needed.
Prepare cell suspension for AT2 cell isolation by FACS.
Resuspend cells in sorting buffer at a concentration of 4–6 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Transfer 2.5 mL of cell suspension into a 5 mL round-bottom tube.
Centrifuge the tube at 250 × g for 5 minutes at 8°C.
Aspirate the supernatant and resuspend cells in 100 μL of antibody mix.
Incubate the cells for 20 minutes at 4°C in the dark.
Add 1 mL of sorting buffer to the tube.
Centrifuge the tube again at 250 × g for 5 minutes at 8°C.
Resuspend the cells in 350 μL of sorting buffer.
Keep the tube on ice in the dark until sorting is performed.
Isolate AT2 cells by FACS.
Add 7 μL of 7-AAD to the cell suspension.
Incubate the sample for 5 minutes on ice in the dark.
Briefly vortex the tube.
Pass samples through a cell strainer before sorting.
After gating cells in the plot of forward scatter (FSC)-area versus side scatter (SSC)-area, identify dead cells as 7-AAD positive cells.
Exclude doublets based on FSC-height vs. FSC-width and SSC-height vs. SSC-width plots.
Identify AT2 cells as EpCAMmedMHCII+ among CD45−CD31− cells.
Sort AT2 cells into a 15 mL conical tube containing 11 mL of processing medium.
Centrifuge cells at 300 × g for 10 minutes at 8°C.
Resuspend cells in PBS.
Count the total cell number.
Adjust cell count to 400,000 cells/100 μL for AT2 cell transplantation.
Anesthetize BLM model mice with 3% isoflurane for 2 minutes.
Hang the mouse by its front teeth on a rubber band at a 45-degree angle.
Apply 100 μL of single-cell suspension for oropharyngeal aspiration.
